PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Paste blueprints over existing blocks to re-place the destroyed ones
PluginData.Description:
Lets the paste tool place a blueprint over the ship it was made from. Blocks already there are kept as they are, only the missing ones are placed. Use it to repair a damaged ship from its blueprint or from a copy made before the damage.
Load the blueprint into the paste tool and aim at the damaged ship: the preview snaps onto it where the blueprint matches the ship, in any rotation. Place it to rebuild the missing blocks. A blueprint which does not match the ship is refused as usual.
Works on any server: only the missing blocks are sent, and the server checks them as usual. Sub-grids (rotor and piston tops) are not placed by a repair paste.
